description: This file defines the DeviceStatusService class, which provides various device status information such as battery, thermal, storage, network status, and device info. It implements the DeviceStatusServicing protocol and uses Apple-specific APIs like UIDevice and ProcessInfo.

classes.name: DeviceStatusService
classes.description: A final class that provides device status information such as battery, thermal, storage, network, and device info. It conforms to the DeviceStatusServicing protocol and is designed to run on the main actor.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current device status, including battery, thermal, storage, network status, and uptime.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Returns a payload with device information such as device name, model, system info, app version, build, and locale.

methods.name: batteryStatus
methods.description: Retrieves current battery level and state, along with low power mode status.

methods.name: thermalStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current thermal state of the device.

methods.name: storageStatus
methods.description: Retrieves total, free, and used storage space on the device.

methods.name: fallbackAppBuild
methods.description: Provides a fallback value ('0') if the app build string is empty.
